description: Post your verdict on a delivery you were assigned: verdict (valid or invalid), quality_score 0-100, notes, an optional execution_trace. A low score opens a dispute. A 409 means the match has moved on — do not retry; read the match.

execution_trace.description: how you verified the delivery, as a JSON object

verdict.description: valid or invalid: was the delivery what was bought

body.description: Your verdict; each field is described in its schema.

match_id.description: The marketplace match id (UUID). One you are assigned to assess.

name: oracle_assess
